content.comment_body: Hello, I would like to clarify what is meant by 4xRelay/10A. Does each individual output (Q1) support a maximum of 10A, or is the combined total of the four outputs limited to 10A? Please advise. Thank you.
Hi [user_name], 4xRelay/10A indicates that there are four relay outputs, and each relay is rated for a maximum of 10A. It may be helpful to review the technical specifications in the manual: [url]

Hello, Please be aware that the relays are not guaranteed to handle 10A continuously in all situations. For example, using these relays for a 10A motor may only work briefly. If your load approaches the relay’s maximum limit, it's recommended to use an external relay. The same advice applies for high switching frequencies. For more details about the relais used, it is the Schrack V23061-A1007-A302 (24V version; for 12V units, use the relay with a 12V coil). Consult the attached datasheet for further information. Regards,
Hello [user_name], you are correct. I recommended reviewing the technical specifications, paying close attention to the derating curves, number of operations, and related parameters.
Thank you for the information. I will use this module for my spotlights setup. Have a great day.
